result.summary: Wrote lib/letflow/design/gh2883-scope-enforcement-break-glass.md (design only). Mechanism: Letflow.Release.ScopeBreakGlass.run/5 called via bin/letflow rpc (no Mix, no eval) plus a thin Mix task letflow.scope_enforcement.break_glass; new ScopeEnforcement.flip_out_of_band/3 sharing two private helpers (lock A then tenants row, then the single changeset write plus audit) with flip/4, which is unchanged. Only on -> shadow or on -> off; mandatory reason; mandatory attested operator label stored in after_state with actor_id NULL (audit actor column is a UUID); lock order lock_timeout, A, T, C; restarts the shadow window by construction (T0 reads the same action); confirm-slug guard plus dry run; works with zero admins; no ids printed; one constant fault log line. Tests T-BG-1..32, mutants MU-BG-1..26, AC map, runbook text, SEC rulings S-BG1..S-BG12, open questions OQ-1..OQ-10. REWORK r1 (SEC design gate PASS_WITH_FINDINGS, CDV r0a fixes kept): F-1 explicit transaction timeout 3xL+10s above the three lock waits (T-BG-14c, MU-BG-27); F-2 text scan over all of lib/ limited to the three allowed files, apply/3 and capture forms, each scan proven live; F-3 after_state node added and operator label in refusal/fault log lines only when valid; F-4 Mix form dev and CI only (moduledoc, runbook); RA-B1 accepted as 0051 A11 with three edits.
